name: grid-cards-launch-remotion
description: Cards launch video: the 3D card plate (rendered by ../, the reel app) composited in Remotion.

scripts.render:square: npx remotion render src/index.ts CardsLaunch-Square exports/cards-launch-square.mp4 --codec h264 --video-bitrate 16M
scripts.render:landscape: npx remotion render src/index.ts CardsLaunch-Landscape exports/cards-launch-landscape.mp4 --codec h264 --video-bitrate 16M
scripts.render:portrait: npx remotion render src/index.ts CardsLaunch-Portrait exports/cards-launch-portrait.mp4 --codec h264 --video-bitrate 16M
